You can upgrade to HBO Max Standard or HBO Max Premium via Sky Marketplace, further terms apply. To access HBO Max, you will need to have or create an HBO Max account and agree to HBO Max’s terms of use and privacy policy.

Sky Ultimate TV customers with pre-existing HBO Max: If you currently pay for HBO Max, taking this service via Sky may result in two HBO Max subscriptions. To avoid this, manage your existing subscription with your current provider before activating HBO Max through Sky.

Sky Ultimate TV customers with pre-existing HBO Max: If you currently pay for HBO Max, taking this service via Sky may result in two HBO Max subscriptions. To avoid this, manage your existing subscription with your current provider before activating HBO Max through Sky.

HBO Max: Access to HBO Max Basic with Ads is included with your Sky Ultimate TV subscription and allows you to watch on two screens in HD. You can upgrade to HBO Max Standard or HBO Max Premium via Sky Marketplace, further terms apply. HBO Max is streamed over broadband; a minimum download speed of 5 Mbps is recommended for HBO Max Basic with Ads and HBO Max Standard and 50 Mbps for HBO Max Premium. To access HBO Max, you will need to have or create an HBO Max account and agree to HBO Max’s terms of use and privacy policy.

Sky Ultimate TV customers with pre-existing HBO Max: If you currently pay for HBO Max, taking this service via Sky may result in two HBO Max subscriptions. To avoid this, manage your existing subscription with your current provider before activating HBO Max through Sky.

You can upgrade to HBO Max Standard or HBO Max Premium via Sky Marketplace, further terms apply.
